privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: Futlance values the privacy and security of its users. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected while using the website, how this data is used, stored, and protected. By using Futlance, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.collectDescription: Depending on the features used, Futlance may collect the following information:
privacy.collect1: Browsing information, such as IP address, browser, operating system, and language.
privacy.collect2: Cookies and similar technologies to improve the user experience.
privacy.collect3: Access statistics collected through analytics tools.
privacy.collect4: Name, email address, and profile picture when the user chooses to sign in with a Google account.
privacy.collect5: Phone number provided by the user to use the Fan Assistant service (when available).
privacy.collect6: Favorite team selected to personalize notifications and content.
privacy.collect7: Subscription-related information, such as the subscribed plan, subscription status, and renewal dates.
privacy.collect8: Other information voluntarily provided by the user while using the services.
privacy.useDescription: The collected data may be used to:
privacy.use1: Display personalized content based on user preferences.
privacy.use2: Improve the browsing experience and website performance.
privacy.use3: Send Fan Assistant notifications when the service is subscribed to by the user.
privacy.use5: Ensure platform security and prevent fraudulent activities.
privacy.use6: Comply with legal and regulatory obligations when necessary.
privacy.shareText: Futlance does not sell users' personal data. Some information may be shared only when necessary to operate the services, such as with Google account authentication providers, analytics tools, advertising services, payment processors, notification providers, and other technology providers used by the platform.
privacy.cookiesText: Futlance uses cookies to remember preferences, improve the browsing experience, measure performance, generate access statistics, and display content or advertising when applicable. Users can manage or disable cookies directly in their browser settings, although some features may be affected.
privacy.securityText: Futlance adopts technical and organizational measures to protect stored information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Despite our efforts to keep data secure, no system is completely immune to risks.
privacy.right1: Request access to their personal data.
privacy.right2: Request the correction or updating of information.
privacy.right3: Request the deletion of their personal data, subject to legal obligations.
privacy.right4: Cancel their subscription and stop receiving notifications.
privacy.changesText: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect legal, technical, or operational changes. The latest version will always be available on this page.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or the processing of personal data, please contact us by email:

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.whatText: Cookies are small text files stored in the user's browser while browsing a website. They allow preferences to be remembered, improve website performance, enhance security, and provide a more personalized experience.
cookiesPage.typesTitle: 2. What Types of Cookies Do We Use?
cookiesPage.typesDescription: Futlance may use the following categories of cookies:
cookiesPage.type1: Essential cookies: required for the basic operation of the website, such as remembering preferences and keeping features active.
cookiesPage.type2: Performance cookies: used to understand how visitors use Futlance and continuously improve the platform.
cookiesPage.type3: Preference cookies: store settings such as language and other preferences selected by the user.
cookiesPage.type4: Advertising cookies: may be used by advertising partners to display more relevant ads.
cookiesPage.useText: Cookies are used to improve navigation, store preferences, generate access statistics, measure performance, enhance security, and provide users with a better experience.
cookiesPage.manageText: Users can accept, block, or delete cookies directly in their browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may limit some Futlance features.
cookiesPage.thirdPartyText: Futlance may use third-party services, such as analytics tools, authentication providers, advertising services, and other technology providers. These services may use their own cookies in accordance with their respective privacy policies.
cookiesPage.contactText: If you have any questions about our Cookie Policy, please contact us by email:

terms.acceptanceText: By accessing or using Futlance, users declare that they have read, understood, and agree to these Terms of Use. If users do not agree with any provision of this document, they are advised not to use the services provided by the platform.
terms.useDescription: Futlance provides football-related information, including news, live matches, match schedules, standings, statistics, and other sports content. Users agree to use the platform responsibly and undertake to:
terms.use1: Use the website only for lawful purposes.
terms.use2: Not engage in activities that may compromise the security or stability of the platform.
terms.use3: Not use bots, automated scripts, or any mechanism that may interfere with the operation of Futlance.
terms.use4: Respect the copyrights and intellectual property rights of the content provided.
terms.accountText: Some features may require users to create an account, such as signing in through a Google Account. Users are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided and for the security of their accounts.
terms.subscriptionDescription: When available, Futlance may offer subscription-based services, including the Fan Assistant. The following conditions may apply to this service:
terms.subscription1: Each subscription may be linked to only one football team.
terms.subscription2: Notifications may include pre-match alerts, match start notifications, final results, and news related to the selected team.
terms.subscription3: Notification delivery will depend on the availability of third-party services used by Futlance.
terms.subscription4: Users must keep their contact information up to date to ensure the service operates correctly.
terms.subscription5: Feature availability may vary according to future platform updates.
terms.subscription6: Futlance may add new features or modify existing ones, always in accordance with these Terms of Use.
terms.paymentDescription: Subscription services may be charged according to the plan selected by the user.
terms.payment1: Payments may be processed by specialized and secure companies.
terms.payment2: Renewals, when applicable, will follow the conditions provided at the time of purchase.
terms.payment3: Prices and payment methods may be changed in the future, with prior notice to users.
terms.cancelText: Users may cancel their subscription at any time. After cancellation, services will remain available until the end of the subscribed period, unless otherwise stated at the time of purchase.
terms.responsibilityDescription: Futlance works to keep information accurate and up to date but does not guarantee uninterrupted service availability. Users acknowledge that:
terms.responsibility1: Delays or temporary interruptions may occur due to maintenance, technical failures, or third-party service outages.
terms.responsibility2: Sports results, statistics, and news depend on external sources and may be subject to change.
terms.responsibility3: Notifications may occasionally be delayed due to the unavailability of external providers.
terms.responsibility4: Futlance shall not be liable for damages resulting from temporary unavailability of the platform or third-party services.
terms.copyrightText: Futlance's visual identity, including its name, logo, layout, content created by the platform, and other proprietary elements, is protected by applicable law. Reproduction without authorization is prohibited.
